name: Mahou Shoujo Žižek-chan!
source:
A visual novel about magical girls and ideology.

Join our cute, 14 year old heroine, Slavoj Žižek, as she makes a pact with a strange, light-pink alien from another planet, Theorina, to become a magical theorist girl and save the world from ideology! Fighting alongside her is the cool and mysterious beauty, Lacan, who seems to have a gloomy outlook on life - but why?

Will Žižek’s optimism and faith in humanity fade as she attempts to make the world a better place - or will she succeed in her mission to bring down the consumerist society around her using the powers of love and hope? You will have to read to find out….

The 'Žižek' is this VN is a cute and female version of the very real (and very alive) philosopher, [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zizek]Slavoj Žižek[/url], and the 'Lacan' is a cute and female and not-dead version of the very real (and now dead) psychoanalyst [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jacques_Lacan]Jacques Lacan[/url].

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=25077]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
